entry.title: Double Ligero Chiselito Natural
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, leather, cedar, toast and dense tobacco sweetness drive the Natural Chiselito, with the Ecuadorian Sumatra sun-grown wrapper putting more dry spice and aromatic wood around the ligero-heavy Dominican core. The compact chisel shape keeps the smoke concentrated and forceful, with a firm savoury centre and a long pepper-and-cedar finish.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. CigarWorld lists the exact 5″ × 44 Natural single at A$34.37, but it is currently unavailable.

note: Add the Natural/Sun Grown counterpart to the existing Double Ligero Chiselito Maduro as a standalone blend entry. The exact Australian single is currently unavailable, so it remains listed with stock out rather than being omitted or nested as a size.
